meanings.note: Adds a reason or an obvious truth.

examples.trans: I did tell you, you know!

examples.text: Садись, не бойся. Я ведь сам чуть тебя не отпустил.
examples.trans: Sit down, don't be afraid. I very nearly let you go myself.
You are saving our evening banquet.

examples.text: Я просто переживаю за вечерний сервис.
examples.trans: I am simply worried about the evening service.

examples.text: Это билеты на хороший вечерний концерт.
examples.trans: These are tickets to a good evening concert.

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

meanings.en: far, far away, a long way

examples.trans: The shop is far from the house.

examples.text: Насколько далеко зашло всё это следствие?
examples.trans: How far has this whole investigation gone?
We could open a salon for you.

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.

related.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.
Don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Сейчас будешь чинить трубу. И унитаз не забудь помыть.
examples.trans: Now you're going to fix the pipe. And don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Если опоздают, пицца бесплатно. Может, закажем?
examples.trans: If they're late, the pizza is free. Maybe we should order?

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.en: it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.

examples.trans: We're trying to create a special warm atmosphere here.

related.gloss: to have a change of scene

examples.text: Хотите отправить меня на отдых, да?
examples.trans: You want to send me off to rest, do you?

meanings.note: Used as an exclamation of approval.

examples.text: Отлично, Ваня! Вот это твой образ!
examples.trans: Perfect, Vanya! That right there is your look!
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: + dative of the person: поверить ему

examples.text: Со своего телефона? И все поверили?

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)

examples.text: Поговори с Аракеляном. Пусть он заберёт заявление.
examples.trans: Talk to Arakelyan. Get him to withdraw his statement.

meanings.en: to please, to be to someone's liking
meanings.note: + dative: тебе понравится = you'll like it

examples.trans: Don't be afraid, you'll like it.

examples.text: А придётся! Не бойся, тебе понравится.
examples.trans: Well, you'll have to! Don't be afraid, you'll like it.

meanings.en: to happen, take place, go on
meanings.note: Что происходит? = What is going on?

examples.trans: What is going on? I don't understand.

examples.text: Мы не знаем, что с нашей дочерью происходит!
examples.trans: We don't know what is happening with our daughter!

проконтролировать.gloss: to keep an eye on, to check, to supervise

meanings.en: to supervise, to keep watch over, to check

examples.trans: Nina, keep an eye on him, please.
I'll keep an eye on him.

examples.text: Но вы, Нина! Я же просил вас всё проконтролировать!
examples.trans: But you, Nina! I asked you to keep everything under control!

meanings.note: short form only: рад, рада, радо, рады; no long-form cases

examples.trans: I'm very glad to see you.

examples.text: Ну что ты? Я очень рад тебя видеть.
examples.trans: Oh, come on! I'm very glad to see you.

examples.text: Это расслабляет! И я должен понимать их психологию! Всё, идите!
examples.trans: It relaxes me! And I must understand their psychology! That's all, go!

examples.text: Всё честно, Лёха. Взрослые не умеют ждать.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

points at something: это моё = that's mine
